$sources: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3 (specified uniformly distributed live loads on an area of floor or roof) and 4.1.4.1(3) (partitions)
source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3 for the uses below; the other uses keep the parent's ASCE 7-22 Table 4.3-1 values (named in their rows) until checked

residential.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, residential areas within dwelling units

residentialPublic.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, residential areas: lobbies and corridors serving the public

dwelling.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, residential areas within dwelling units

office.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, office areas not located in the basement and first storey

officeLobby.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, office areas in the basement and first storey, lobbies

officeCorridor.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, corridors, lobbies and aisles

corridorFirst.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, corridors, lobbies and aisles

corridorAbove.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, corridors, lobbies and aisles

classroom.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, classrooms with or without fixed seats

assemblyFixed.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, assembly areas with fixed seats that have backs over at least 80 % of the area

assemblyMovable.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, assembly areas: other (movable seats, lobbies)

retailGround.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, retail and wholesale areas

retailUpper.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, retail and wholesale areas

parking.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, garages for passenger cars

stairs.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, exits and fire escapes

roof.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3, roofs (at least 1.0 kPa, or the snow load where larger)

sources.uses: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.5.3 (the rows above; see VERIFY.md)
sources.partitions: NBCC 2020 4.1.4.1(3): partitions at least 1.0 kPa where their location is not known (SAEngine keeps the parent's live load case for them: on the safe side, 1.5 in place of 1.25)
